start.question: How do I start a quick practice test?
start.answer: Go to the <link>Exam library</link> and pick a realistic quick test, no account required to get started.

plan.question: How is the personalized study path created?
plan.answer: After you finish the quick test, the system analyzes your error rate in each domain and automatically generates a path that fills your knowledge gaps.

review.question: What if I find a question or answer that needs reviewing?
review.answer: Please email <mail>{email}</mail> with the exam code and question number. Our technical team will verify and update it.

certificate.question: Does {siteShortName} issue official certificates?
certificate.answer: {siteShortName} is an exam prep and skill assessment platform. Official certificates are issued by the vendors (AWS, Microsoft, Google, LPI) when you take the real exam.
